description: Full legal or personal name of business owner for authentication and root accountability.
Unique email address used for login, password recovery, and tenant verification.
Secure password (min 8 chars, confirmed) for owner authentication.
Mobile contact number for owner 2FA and business alerts.
Legal/trading name of the retail business.
Retail category (e.g., General Store, Supermarket, Pharmacy, Electronics, Apparel).
Official business contact phone.
Official support or public inquiry email for business.
Official business website URL.
Primary country of operation (defaults to Pakistan).
Default monetary currency (e.g., PKR, USD, AED, SAR).
Operating timezone (e.g., Asia/Karachi) for midnight reporting reconciliation.
Name of initial operating branch (defaults to 'Main Branch').
Unique branch identifier code (e.g., MAIN, BR-01).
Street address of the primary retail branch.
City where primary branch is located.
Custom header text printed at the top of customer receipts.
Custom thank-you or return policy message printed at bottom of receipts.
Prefix for invoice numbers (e.g., INV-).
National Tax Number (NTN) or Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN).
Whether sales are permitted when physical stock count is zero (defaults to block).
Credit/debit card data must NEVER be collected for free release under data minimization.
